notes.title: We actually made it! Patch is LIVE
notes.notes:
That was close, we've made it on time!

All the work on Stay Close and Testing were just finalized minutes ago! That wouldn't be possible without the contribution of our new programmer who managed to finish all the tasks!

Stay Close is much more optimized now! Loads 2-3 times faster than before, as well as lot of minor bugs were eliminated. Previously stated in the announcement before there was a lot of changes, including new A.I and level design. 

The patch is a big deal, because provides us a really good foundation to build and implement more to the game without worrying the issues will stack. 

Hope you'll enjoy it! I can't wait to stalk new videos on YouTube and Twitch! 

Next patch will include new animations, sounds and maybe expanded level design. 

Great Summer, residents!

notes.title: Incoming patch - Next Week (End of June)
notes.notes:
Hello residents,

The game will be patched very soon, including a lot of changes. 
~ Graphics improvements
~ New Monster A.I
~ Level Design Improvements/Changes
~ Secret Event
~ German Translation
~ Many minor fixes

Please note the patch could be unstable for a while due to the rapid changes. Please report any bugs and expect hotfixes! (we gonna try make it as stable till then).


Happy Steam Summer Sale!

notes.title: First Day Release - Upcoming Patches
notes.notes:
Today was the day!

Finally bringing the game to the community. We're receiving a lot of feedback and stable patches are incoming! 

It's first day build, so expect some issues, but nothing game-breaking. 

Best,
Neko

notes.title: Why we don't release the game?
notes.notes:
Hello community!

Want to thank you for the incredible support!

The most interested folks, following the progress of Stay Close noticed the game has some delays! 

That's due to fixing glitches and make sure not to disappoint the community with our game. 

It's really exciting to see many people who can't see the game out, and we know how bad it could be to keep waiting for something you want, however it's for the greater good to fix all issues before release so you have a nice time playing!

Best wishes,
Neko!
